title: Route 66: Travel Through the Bible
edition: 3rd ed. 2007 (Student Manual ISBN 978-1-59557-109-0, 6th printing 2019); current Teacher's Manual ISBN 978-1-59557-157-1

summary: A one-year, 70-lesson survey of all 66 books of the Bible for middle school, taught two lessons a week. It moves through the Old Testament from Genesis to Malachi, then the Gospels, Acts, Paul's letters and the general letters to Revelation, giving each book's setting, key events and figures, main themes, and one life application. The stated aims are to grasp Scripture's overall story and to see how God uses imperfect people to show his grace.

notes: The Student Manual's contents page prints lesson titles without numbers; lesson numbers come from the publisher's scope and sequence, which matches the same order. The course has 12 unit tests and 2 semester exams. The school's teacher ISBN (978-1-59557-060-4, 2007) is an earlier printing of the Teacher's Manual than the one sold now (978-1-59557-157-1); the student edition is the same. Positive Action announces a new edition for January 2027, so lesson titles may change if the school reorders. The Open Library record cited in the work list (https://openlibrary.org/isbn/9781595571090) has a table_of_contents field, but it lists the whole Positive Action series by grade, not this book's lessons, so it was not used for this outline.
